caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet-like object positioned in profile view, with the rounded crown on the left and the front brim facing right. The bonnet is rendered in light beige and cream tones, with subtle shading used to indicate folds and three-dimensionality. Delicate, swirling embroidery patterns are faintly visible on the main body of the bonnet. The brim is edged with a scalloped lace trim and a narrow decorative border. Two wide beige ribbons, attached at the bottom of the bonnet, are shown crossed over each other and hanging downward. The background is a plain, light tan color, with no additional objects or details present.
title: Lady's Cap
